canon: CANON.md §1: Tong-Nou is a giant green head floating in darkness. Inside the head is a world: five lands, a marketplace, a mountain, a shrine, and now — a trial by combat.
description: The Purifier. A giant green head floats in the dark, and the trial happens inside its gaze. Its eyes follow the fighters.

lighting.note: Sickly green god-light from the head itself
